author: Inside Edition
description: A seaplane had a nightmare landing in New York City's East River. One witness praised the skill of the seaplane pilot saying he "pulled a sully." That is a reference to the legendary Chskey "Sully" Sullenberger, who had to land an airliner on the Hudson River, saving all 155 people on board in 2009. Dramatic video from inside that seaplane was shot by 16-year-old Khloe Todd. She spoke with Inside Edition's Justin Finch.
title: Seaplane Makes Emergency Landing In New York City's East River

author: Inside Edition
description: A red card reversal? A decision by FIFA officials to suspend a player's ban is certainly raising red flags among fans of the sport. Folarin Balogun of the USA was to be banned during the team's next game against Belgium after receiving a red card during the match against Bosnia and Herzegovina on July 1st. But FIFA officials suspended the ruling after being contacted by President Donald Trump. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: FIFA Suspends Suspension For American Player After Call From Trump
